summary.text: Heavy Soil Comeback is the third killer move of Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress. Wu Shuai gains it with accumulated soil mountain and peaceful burial after he learns that house.

claims.text: After learning the general information of Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress, Wu Shuai gains that Immortal Gu House’s three killer moves. The first is called accumulated soil mountain, the second is called peaceful burial, and the third is called heavy soil comeback.

Accumulated soil mountain is the one that opens his eyes: an earth path killer move with formation path effect. It lets a Gu Immortal stack earth path Gu worms into an Immortal Gu House even with zero formation path attainment, and gaining it is gaining the foundation of the house. The house core is that immortal killer move rather than a core Immortal Gu. Peaceful burial is the method he uses to seal the female immortal for a time, suppress her injuries, and let the house treat her. Heavy soil comeback is named in that set and is not shown in use in this exploration.

Fang Yuan fields rank eight Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress. The house has no core Immortal Gu. Its core is immortal killer moves, it has three core killer moves, and accumulated soil mountain is the most important.
